name: Input
summary: Collect one line of text with shared label, description, and validation parts.

useWhen: Collecting a short, single-line text value.
avoidWhen: For multiline content, numeric ranges, or a predefined choice.

obligations: Uses the label, description, and error parts shared with other Mux UI fields, and native input serialization.

behavior: Root owns the field: value, defaultValue, and onChange go on Input.Root.
Root also takes size, disabled, invalid, required, and readOnly.
Root's onChange receives the new string, not an event.
On Root, size is sm, md, or lg; on Input.Input, size is the native character count.
Input.Input is the native input, so name, type, placeholder, and autoComplete go on it.
A named Input submits its text; the name goes on Input.Input, not Root.
Input.Input also takes the native onChange, which receives the change event and runs alongside Root's.
Input.Root's ref is its wrapping div.
Input.Input's ref is the native input, the one to focus.
Input.Description and Input.Error are linked to the input.
Input.Error shows whenever it is mounted, so render it only while the field is invalid.
accessibility: Uses the label, description, and error parts shared with other Mux UI fields, and native input serialization.

requirements.reason: Native dynamic colors do not apply to the React web binding.
Native font metrics do not apply to the React web binding.
